coverage_notes.result_summary: CMS Public Notices directly checked first; 12 targeted web searches completed. No new qualifying and nonduplicate healthcare access loss, official CMS action, or concrete restoration verified within the hourly observation interval.
coverage_notes.limitations: Search results contained many older, out-of-country, and unrelated items; non-exhaustive coverage, with possible indexing delays especially for small rural providers and U.S. territories. Older closure announcements were not misrepresented as newly discovered hourly events.
coverage_notes.controls: One private watch-ledger heartbeat only. No approvals, public publication, schedule modification, task disabling, or production collector changes.
